name: Binary Representation & Two's Complement
description: How integers, negative numbers, and numerical logic are represented at the hardware level using bits and two's complement arithmetic.
learning_objectives: Explain why physical digital hardware naturally operates in binary (on/off voltage levels).
Derive two's complement from first principles as a solution to avoid separate subtraction circuits.
Perform signed and unsigned bitwise calculations and predict integer overflow behaviors.
Contrast two's complement with sign-magnitude and one's complement, articulating the zero-representation trade-off.
